 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Chelsea Women are currently leading the Women's Super League thanks to goal difference, with Manchester City now chasing after us. The least we could today against Everton, who do have a good defensive record despite sitting eighth in the table, is keep up the pace.
 Chelsea starting lineup (4-2-3-1): 
Hampton | Carpenter, Buchanan, Bronze, McCabe | Walsh, Cuthbert (c) | Manaka, Kaptein, Baltimore | Malard
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Substitutes from: Peng, Björn, Buurman, Potter, Nüsken, Dragoni, Hamano, Thompson, Beever-Jones 
 Everton starting eleven: 
Brosnan (c) | Kitagawa, Ishikawa, Layzell, Blundell, Mace, Wheeler, Van Gool, Pacheco, Vignola, Momiki
 Substitutes from: Foster-Inman, Cain, Rantala, Mouchon, Finnigan, Galli, Silcock 
 Date / Time: Saturday, November 7, 2026, 12:45 GMT; 7:45 am EST
 Venue: Stamford Bridge, SW6, UK
 Referee: Lisa Benn
 On TV: Sky Sports, Sky Mix (UK); CBS Sports Golazo (US); elsewhere 
 Streaming: Sky Go (UK); Paramount+ (US)
